create_categorical_distribution_nn: create a Categorical neural network module that maps inputs to a categorical distribution over outputs
sample_from_fixed_categorical: sample an action from a FixedCategorical distribution and return it with an extra dimension
compute_log_probs_fixed_categorical: compute the log probabilities of given actions using a FixedCategorical distribution
